answer: Each bonded identity is an inlet into consensus, but coordinating k identities to equivocate creates up to k(k−1)/2 correlated evidence pairs, so the penalty scales as O(k²), not as k independent fines. Detection slashes their escrow under asymmetric depreciation; the swarm’s capital loss carries an exponential multiplier, making a grove of sybils costly to maintain even before conviction, while nectar-like rewards cannot offset that risk.
